newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 15.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's edition of Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Ted Turner said his interest in the movie business was ephemeral with the announcement that Time Warner Inc will phase out Turner Pictures as a stand-alone label after having merged with Turner Broadcasting System Inc.

WASHINGTON - Federal Communications Commission Chairman Reed Hundt met with the president of the Distilled Spirits Council of the United States to discuss the trade group's decision to lift a voluntary ban on broadcast advertising for whiskey and other hard liquors.
NEW YORK - French bank Societe Generale is allying itself with Beverly Hills firm Bannon & Co to form Societe Generale Bannon.
